caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing in the center within an oval frame that has a decorative border featuring scrollwork and floral designs in shades of red, gold, blue, and cream. The figure wears a crown, a reddish-brown cape or shawl, a white lace apron or dress, and a dark skirt. She holds a green palm branch in her left hand and a thin rod or scepter in her right hand. The background shows a natural setting with a green and yellow gradient sky, brown clouds, and a distant arched bridge, under which blue water flows. On the left side of the composition, two smaller human figures are visible, one in a crouched or kneeling posture near an arched opening, possibly a cave or building entrance. The ground is rendered in earthy browns and greens. At the bottom right of the frame is an area of text, reading "FLOWER PICTURE W.K. REICHHELD."
title: Santo de Retablo
